error.noTemplateScan: InDesign did not return a template scan.
error.noLayoutPlan: Could not create the InDesign layout plan.
error.noObservation: InDesign did not return layout observations.
error.noDocumentDump: InDesign did not return a document structure.
error.noExportPath: InDesign did not confirm the export path.

diagnostics.roleFallback: No reliable match was found for {{role}}; Folio will use a fallback layout.
diagnostics.roleAmbiguous: Several candidates matched {{role}}; Folio selected {{name}}. Candidates: {{candidates}}
diagnostics.pageFallback: No page was clearly marked as {{role}}; Folio selected one by page order.
diagnostics.pageAmbiguous: Several pages could serve as {{role}}; Folio selected one automatically.
diagnostics.articleFlowMissing: No article flow frame was found; Folio will create one in the output copy.
diagnostics.styleFallback: Folio will use a compatible style or InDesign defaults for {{role}}.
diagnostics.styleMissing: The {{role}} style is missing; affected content will use default formatting.
diagnostics.styleMissingForContent: Some content has no matching style; its text will be kept.
diagnostics.styleKindMismatch: The {{role}} candidate has the wrong style type and was skipped.
diagnostics.styleRoleConflict: One style matched multiple roles; Folio assigned it to {{assignedRole}} and will use a compatible fallback for {{role}}.
diagnostics.frameKindMismatch: The {{role}} candidate is the wrong kind of frame; Folio will find another or create a fallback.
diagnostics.fallbackFrameCreated: The selected {{role}} frame could not be used; Folio created a replacement in the output copy.
diagnostics.coverImageFrameMissing: The cover has no image frame; body images will still be placed when possible.
diagnostics.styleApplyFailed: InDesign could not apply one of the template styles; the related content will still be kept.
diagnostics.annotationTargetMissing: An object assigned to a template role is no longer available; Folio will try a fallback object.
diagnostics.templateIdentityMissing: Template information is incomplete, so Folio could not identify it.
diagnostics.templateInspectionFailed: Folio could not read the template structure: {{details}}.
diagnostics.pageOrderChanged: InDesign could not fully apply the planned page order; generated pages will still be kept.
diagnostics.invalidFrontmatter: The extra information at the start of the article is invalid. Folio ignored it and continued with the text.
diagnostics.titleMismatch: The first level-one heading differs from the article title. The cover uses the article title and the body heading stays.
diagnostics.titleMissing: No article title was found; Folio used the file name or a default title.
diagnostics.parseFailed: Folio could not fully read the article format and tried to keep the source as plain text.
diagnostics.blockSkipped: An article block could not be identified; Folio tried to convert it to readable text.
diagnostics.quoteShapeUnsupported: This quote has an unsupported shape; Folio tried to keep its text.
diagnostics.unknownMetadata: The article contains metadata Folio does not recognize; the body will still be processed.
diagnostics.listFlattened: List formatting was changed to plain text while keeping the list content.
diagnostics.tableFlattened: The table was changed to row text with vertical bars between cells.
diagnostics.codeBlockFlattened: Code block formatting was removed while keeping the code text.
diagnostics.blockFlattened: An uncommon article block was changed to plain text.
diagnostics.inlineImageFlattened: The inline image was separated from its sentence while keeping nearby text.
diagnostics.assetMissing: The image could not be found or placed; Folio tried to add a visible missing-image notice.
diagnostics.assetUnsupported: This image address is unsupported; a missing-image notice will be shown.
diagnostics.assetScanFailed: Image file checks failed; publishing will still continue.
diagnostics.placeholderFailed: InDesign could not create the missing-image notice; article layout will continue.
diagnostics.fontMissing: A template font is missing or substituted; review it in InDesign.
diagnostics.overset: Some text exceeds its frame. The file was generated; adjust it in InDesign.
diagnostics.pageLimit: Automatic page creation reached its limit; some text may still overflow.
diagnostics.textChanged: Some body text differs from the source; review the INDD.
diagnostics.titleChanged: The cover title did not pass the save check; review the INDD.
diagnostics.subtitleChanged: The cover subtitle did not pass the save check; review the INDD.
diagnostics.mainStoryMissing: No article text flow was found in the generated INDD; review the file.
diagnostics.pagesUnverified: InDesign did not return a reliable page count; the interface shows the planned count.
diagnostics.dumpInvalid: InDesign returned an invalid document check result; the INDD will still be kept.
diagnostics.dumpUnavailable: The generated document structure could not be read; the INDD will still be kept.
diagnostics.hostJobFailed: The InDesign job did not complete; review the error details.
diagnostics.pdfFailed: PDF export failed, but Folio will keep the generated INDD.
diagnostics.hostOperationFailed: The InDesign operation did not complete: {{details}}. Folio will still try to keep any generated INDD.
diagnostics.previewFailed: Preview export failed for page {{page}}; successful files will be kept.
diagnostics.previewPartial: Some page previews were not generated; available previews and the INDD were kept.
diagnostics.optionalOutputMissing: An optional file was not generated; available INDD, PDF, previews, and report files were kept.
diagnostics.recoveredAfterIssue: A layout issue occurred, but Folio kept the usable INDD.
